approval_name: Consent to Establish (CTE) under Water and Air Acts
description: Statutory environmental clearance required prior to establishing any industrial plant, discharge outlet, or manufacturing unit in red, orange, or green pollution categories. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Industrial units planning new manufacturing setup or capacity expansion discharging trade effluent or air emissions
documents: Site Plan; Detailed Project Report (DPR); Land Ownership/Lease Deed; Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) / Air Pollution Control Device (APCD) Proposal; Water Balance Diagram
act_rules: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974 (Section 25/26); Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1981 (Section 21)
conditions: Must install adequate effluent treatment and air pollution control devices as per prescribed CPCB/UPPCB norms prior to commissioning.
source_name: UPPCB / Nivesh Mitra Single Window Portal

approval_name: Consent to Operate (CTO) under Water and Air Acts
description: Statutory operational consent required before commencing commercial production or operating industrial machinery discharging effluent or emissions. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Enterprises holding valid Consent to Establish (CTE) that have completed plant construction and equipment installation
documents: Copy of CTE Grant Letter; Compliance Report of CTE Conditions; Environmental Audit / ETP Commissioning Report; Laboratory Effluent Analysis Report; Production Capacity Certificate
act_rules: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974 (Section 25/26); Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1981 (Section 21)
conditions: Valid only when operating within consented emission parameters and water discharge limits.

approval_name: Fire Safety No Objection Certificate (Provisional / Pre-Construction)
description: Pre-construction fire safety clearance ensuring building layouts incorporate statutory emergency exits, fire hydrants, and access roads. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Commercial and industrial units with built-up area exceeding statutory thresholds or storing combustible/hazardous materials
documents: Certified Architectural Building Layout Plan; Key Plan; Site Plan with Emergency Exits; Structural Stability Certificate; Proposed Fire Fighting System Blueprint
act_rules: Uttar Pradesh Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Act 2005; National Building Code of India (NBC 2016 Part IV)
conditions: Subject to on-site physical verification by Chief Fire Officer (CFO) inspecting officer.

approval_name: FSSAI Food Manufacturing and Processing License
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
description: Mandatory statutory license to manufacture, process, pack, or store food products under national standards. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Food Business Operators (FBOs) manufacturing or processing food products in Uttar Pradesh
documents: Food Safety Management System (FSMS) Plan; Blueprint/Layout of Processing Unit; List of Machinery and Equipment; Potable Water Test Report (IS 10500); List of Food Categories Manufactured; Authorized Signatory ID Proof
act_rules: Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 (Section 31); Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations 2011
conditions: Premises must comply with Schedule 4 hygienic and sanitary practices.

approval_name: Factory License and Building Plan Approval
description: Statutory registration and plan approval for manufacturing premises employing 10 or more workers with power, or 20 or more workers without power. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Occupier/Manager of manufacturing premises falling under the definition of a factory
documents: Factory Site Plan and Section Elevation Drawings; Machinery Layout Plan; Form 1 (Particulars of Plant); Process Flow Chart; Title/Lease Deed of Land
act_rules: Factories Act 1948 (Section 6); Uttar Pradesh Factories Rules 1950 (Rule 3 to 5)
conditions: Renewal required annually or multi-year block as notified by state government.
source_name: Directorate of Factories UP / Nivesh Mitra

approval_name: Registration of Principal Employer under Contract Labour Act
description: Registration required for principal employers engaging contract labour for manufacturing or packaging operations. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Establishments employing 20 or more contract workers on any day of the accounting year
documents: Form I Application; List of Contractors with Estimated Worker Count; Trade License / Incorporation Certificate; Authorized Signatory Authorization
act_rules: Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act 1970 (Section 7); UP Contract Labour Rules 1975
conditions: Mandatory welfare amenities (canteen, first-aid, restrooms) must be ensured.

approval_name: Approval for Electrical Installation and DG Set Energization
description: Statutory inspection and energization certificate for HT electrical installations, transformers, and diesel generator sets. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Industrial units installing high-voltage electrical transformers, sub-stations, or DG sets above statutory kVA capacity
documents: Single Line Diagram (SLD) of Electrical Layout; Transformer/DG Set Test Certificates; Earthing Resistance Test Report; Electrical Contractor Completion Certificate (Form A)
act_rules: Electricity Act 2003 (Section 54); Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations 2010
conditions: Equipment must satisfy earthing and safety clearance standards prior to energization.
source_name: Electrical Safety Directorate UP / Nivesh Mitra

approval_name: Registration and Certificate for Use of Industrial Boiler
description: Statutory inspection, hydraulic testing, and registration for steam boilers and steam pipe installations. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Industrial units operating steam boilers exceeding 25 litres capacity with design pressure above 1 kg/cm2
documents: Boiler Manufacturer Test Certificates (Form II, III, IV); Steam Pipeline Drawing; Boiler House Layout; Certified Boiler Attendant Details; Erection Completion Certificate
conditions: Annual hydraulic test and internal inspection mandatory for renewal.
source_name: National Single Window System (NSWS) / UP Boilers

approval_name: Registration as Manufacturer and Packer of Pre-Packaged Commodities
description: Statutory registration under Legal Metrology for packaging food products or goods in pre-determined quantities. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Manufacturers and packers distributing packaged food items, containers, and pre-weighed consumer commodities
documents: Sample Product Package Label / Artwork (showing MRP, net weight, batch, customer care); Manufacturing License Copy; GST Registration; Trade License
act_rules: Legal Metrology Act 2009 (Section 19); Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 (Rule 27)
conditions: Labels must comply with mandatory declarations including font size, unit measurement symbols, and manufacturer details.
source_name: National Single Window System (NSWS) / Legal Metrology

approval_name: Permission for Tree Felling for Industrial Site Development
description: Statutory permission required before clearing non-exempt tree species on private or acquired industrial plots. DEMO RECORD — verify against current official source before production use.
who_can_apply: Landowners / developers executing site leveling or construction on land containing protected tree species
documents: Land Revenue Records (Khasra/Khatauni); Geo-referenced Plot Layout showing Trees to be Felled; Afforestation Undertaking (1:10 compensatory plantation)
act_rules: Uttar Pradesh Protection of Trees Act 1976 (Section 4 to 7)
conditions: Compensatory plantation of native tree saplings is mandatory.
source_name: Department of Forests UP / Nivesh Mitra
